layers.note: A herb of the floor of moist conifer and mixed forest.

heat_load.note: Favours cool, shaded aspects and ravines; scarce on hot south-west slopes.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 1,500 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

sun_tolerance.note: Wilts in hot sun; a plant of shaded, moist woods.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS).
